inputs.name: T-LESS Primesense scene 000001, frames 000000 through 000023, FFV1 clip

scenario: Boot the NPU observation DTB on a Zero 4. Check driver registration and the PMIC rail. Decode the FFV1 clip to 8-bit grayscale before running the read-only diagnostic stages. Check the baseline kernel response to the typed tile ioctl.
expected: The diagnostic driver attaches at stage 0 with no task attempt. Decode all 24 frames. Stages 1 and 2 succeed and stage 3 returns EBUSY. The baseline kernel returns ENOTTY for the typed tile ioctl.
observed: The A733 diagnostic driver registered vipcore. AXP8191 reported DCDC2 enabled at 800 mV. FFmpeg 9.0.2 decoded all 24 FFV1 frames at 720 × 540 before stage 1. The raw grayscale SHA-256 is 8cc965a92a20cd3bc74f0752ec0819c8292f41bd8a7473b03e3af9c5e2ae8dd6. Read-only stages 1 and 2 returned success. Stage 3 returned EBUSY. The tile ioctl returned ENOTTY and the task attempt counter stayed at zero.
limits: This baseline run stopped at stage 3 before NPU identity reads, DMA, IRQ or model execution.
The clip decode is a media input check. It provides no NPU throughput or contour quality measurement.
The test records the attached driver and observed rail. The board revision is unknown.
